title: Kit manual fragment frontmatter
description: Frontmatter of manuals/kits/<kit-id>/<kit-version>/<role>.md (spec 11, D48-D50). The parser reads a restricted subset: 'key: value' lines and one 'sources:' list of '  - path' lines.

sources.$comment: Repo-relative files the text was derived from, so each statement can be traced to Kit code (D49).
